scope: Directed recovery of three previously uninspected repositories identified in the original 106-record corpus. No new repository searches, no own models, no market data or test access.
final_inclusion_decision: Parent reviewer; no automatic inclusion or frequency changes by recovery agent.

records.inspection: Repository root, README, notebooks directory tree. Tree contains three notebooks and no scientific manuscript.
records.verified_topic: Bitcoin 7-day average daily realized volatility, GARCH and univariate/multivariate LSTM, with technical indicators.
records.identity_status: Educational/research project README; no identified scientific paper with title/authorship/year/DOI recovered.
records.corrected_reason: DL and Bitcoin volatility are present. A scientific manuscript was not recovered from the inspected repository, so do not exclude as price-only or absence of DL.

records.inspection: Repository root and README. Root contains README, license, gitignore and screenshots.
records.verified_topic: Bitcoin daily volatility with GARCH/EGARCH/LSTM and hybrids; S&P500 ancillary comparison.
records.identity_status: Jacqueline Mageto; MSc group of four, HFU Furtwangen; no scientific manuscript, DOI or editorial year recovered.
records.corrected_reason: DL is explicitly present. Repository documents an MSc project in a README and screenshots rather than an identified full scientific article.

records.inspection: Repository root, README, research-draft.pdf (14 pages), presentation.pdf (same work, not an additional study), commit page.
records.title: A comparative analysis of volatility predictions via EGARCH, Transformer and hybrid EGARCH-Transformer models: changes in forecasting ability after introducing sentiment factors
records.peer_review_status: Not established; repository explicitly asserts no publication status.
records.date_note: Commit date identifies a repository version only, not publication year. PDF has no creation/modification date reported by pdfinfo. Citation may use s.f. and a separate version/access date.
records.possible_eligibility: Identifiable full grey manuscript with methods, DL comparative baseline and numerical results. May be assessed under the same explicit grey-literature policy as S2. Architecture/protocol reproducibility remains partial. Do not assert indexed or peer-reviewed status.

dataset.raw_source: Not sufficiently identified in methods reviewed
dataset.target: One-day-ahead realized volatility (RV1D); precise proxy construction not recovered. Do not equate with sigma7.
dataset.inputs_baseline: OHLCV only; other variants add RV, VIX, S&P500, DXY, EGARCH variance forecasts and Reddit sentiment.

baseline.role: Standalone/pure OHLCV model1; compared with EGARCH and added-feature/hybrid variants
baseline.location: Section3.4 pp6–7; Table1 p7; Table2 p7; Table4 p10

reported_metrics.dispersion: None reported across seeds; seed42 only.

quality_limits: Transformer split 70/30 is not reconciled with EGARCH test window 2024-06-11 through 2024-12-30 (203 days).
DM explicitly not executed due computational cost (introduction and section6.2 p13).
Paper asserts model9 best MAE0.7399, but model1 MAE0.4369 is smaller.
Reported RMSE/R2 imply different target variances under a conventional common-cohort R2 (model1≈1.252 versus model2≈2.063); cohort/metric definition is not verifiable without data.
EGARCH order selection text partly cites out-of-sample performance; apparent risk of selecting using test.
No training code or underlying data permits leakage/availability checks.
Draft and slides use different configuration numbering; count one study and do not cross-map by number alone.
